notes: v2.5.20 - recommended update. Correcting the price on a purchase order line now re-values the stock that was received against it. Receiving records the price as it stands at that moment, so a line corrected afterwards used to leave the material on the shelf carrying the old number permanently - in the worst case ten yards of fiberglass cloth were still valued at over thirteen thousand dollars three months on. Only stock still on the shelf moves: a lot already consumed keeps the cost booked against the job it went into, because a price edit after that point is as likely to be a genuine re-bill as a correction. The re-valuation is written into the order history alongside the price change itself, so the reason the stock value moved is visible later. A lot can now be consumed and split in the units it genuinely converts to - a fabric bought by the roll, counted in yards and recorded as nine square feet to the yard now offers rolls and square feet, and taking off eighteen square feet records two yards against the lot. The units somebody entered against the material come first in the picker rather than being pushed past the end of the list, and near-duplicate units that convert identically are no longer offered side by side, though they are still understood wherever an existing record uses them. In the Planner Global view each project checked-off milestones collapse into a single line at the top of the group, closed by default and opening in place, so a project that has been running a year no longer opens with a screenful of finished work above the work still live; nothing is hidden from the counts. Traveler tiles now grow to fit their own content, so the assembly part number is no longer sliced through the middle of its letters and the current operation, step and department are fully visible instead of half-hidden under the footer. Resin printing automatic material consumption is worked out in the unit the lot is stocked in, so a 500-gram print takes half a kilo from a lot tracked in kilograms instead of five hundred of them - the same calculation the manual consume screen performs - and where the conversion cannot be worked out at all the print is left alone and reported rather than guessed at.
